answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. The jetty of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the zephyr until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the opal of the next round.
